p.i: Te propter odio cateris populis sumus,
In te fauoris pendimus pœnas: tui

main_text.p: Vt autem doceat quomodo fideles se gerere debeant quum tam crudeliter accipiuntur, eodem Psalmo circa medium ait,

p.i: Tamen nec unquam est animus oblitus tui,
Recta pes. etsi penitus abiecti interim
Id te lateret, abditas qui pectoris

main_text.p: Præter ea quæ supra à nobis dicta sunt, duo alia singularis Dei prouidentiæ argumenta in oui-
Multiplicatio o-uium & the marginal side note, left.

page.notes: Left margin side note "Multipli catio o- uium" printed at the foot left, partly faded. Several words in the italic verse are uncertain due to faint print; the running head is "TRACT. DE DEI" in spaced capitals. The last line ends with the catchword "oui-".
